patches.name: The Mall (Tsarigradsko Shose)

proposed_fields.Description: The Mall sits on Tsarigradsko Shose Boulevard in Sofia’s Mladost district, and the cruising reference is specifically to the toilets on underground level −2—not Sofia Ring Mall or Mall of Sofia. The original listing marks evenings as its preferred period, but its more recent comments are men asking who is around or trying to arrange a meeting, rather than reports of something actually happening. The centre has multiple underground parking levels and is normally open for shopping until 22:00. It may be worth knowing about if you’re already there, but there’s no reliable evidence of a regular cruising crowd or a particularly productive time. It’s an ordinary, managed shopping-centre toilet, so the layout, security and access can change.

patches.name: Nissi Beach

proposed_fields.Description: Nissi Beach is one of Ayia Napa’s busiest sandy resort beaches, with beach bars, music, sunbeds and water sports around its shallow bay. It is easy to reach from Nissi Avenue, but that popularity is also the limitation of this cruising listing: the directory discussions from June 2026 are requests to meet, and none identifies a recognisable gay cruising section or reports a confirmed encounter. It’s a holidaymakers’ beach rather than a known men-only or naturist spot, so someone looking specifically for discreet cruising has little concrete information to go on. Note that Cyprus tourism distinguishes Nissi Beach from the neighbouring Nissi Bay Beach and its famous sandbar; the previous pin was on Nissi Bay, not Nissi Beach.

patches.name: Parking Area near Big Greek Flag

proposed_fields.Description: This Paphos entry describes a seafront parking area by a prominent Greek flag. The important practical detail is that the original cruising page actually provides a mapped driving destination at 34.816551, 32.392544; it is not an entirely unlocated spot, as the previous description suggested. The older contributor description says it’s chiefly a place where people meet in cars, with very little privacy and fewer men passing on foot. One 2025 commenter described morning visits, but the more recent June 2026 comments only ask about meeting, so don’t count on those older hours still meaning much. The source pin identifies a starting point, not independently verified legal parking bays, and the exact flag landmark or current access still needs local confirmation.

patches.name: Palladium Shopping Mall WC

proposed_fields.Description: Palladium in central Prague has two toilet areas mentioned by the cruising directory, but they're not equally described: the basement WC on level −2 is the one the original contributor considered more active, while the other is on level +2 by the food court. Both still exist, and the shopping centre's operator confirms that since April 2025 they have been managed by M2C. Admission is 20 CZK for adults, payable in Czech crowns by cash or card. The operator gives −2 opening hours of 07:00–21:00 and +2 of 08:00–22:00. Those are toilet hours, not guaranteed cruising periods, and the late-2025 forum messages are requests to meet rather than reports of encounters. If you're already shopping at Palladium, the two levels explain what the original listing meant; it is still a regular public retail WC, not a sex venue.

patches.name: Weikerlsee

proposed_fields.Description: Weikerlsee in Linz-Pichling is a pair of connected lakes, and the distinction matters. The smaller lake, Kleiner Weikerlsee, is the swimming area: regular bathing is on its southern shore, while the northern side is the official FKK/naturist section. The larger lake is for walking and nature, with swimming prohibited. That naturist shore explains the older cruising directory reference, but it doesn't establish a particular current meeting corner or a reliably active gay crowd. An April 2026 digital check-in is too little to prove men were meeting. The area is a warm-weather recreation destination with footpaths and plenty of other visitors; don't confuse the larger lake or the whole nature reserve with the smaller lake's designated nude-bathing stretch.

patches.name: Terazije public toilet

proposed_fields.Description: This is the public toilet in the underground pedestrian passage beside Palata Albanija, where Terazije meets Sremska and Knez Mihailova in central Belgrade. The location is more precise than a generic 'Terazije toilet': go by the named underground passage rather than looking for facilities on the surface. The city lists the Palata Albanija WC as a free public convenience, normally 07:00–22:30 in winter and 07:00–23:00 in summer. Unlike many other entries, the cruising source has a few actual first-person claims in 2026, including a January visitor saying he met men and a May commenter describing repeated visits. Those are uncorroborated personal reports, not a reason to assume the place is always busy. It is a shared city WC with normal cleaning and visitor rules.

patches.name: Tripla Toilets

proposed_fields.Description: Tripla is the huge shopping and railway complex at Pasila station in Helsinki. The cruising directory names its toilets but doesn’t say which floor or toilet bank, which is the biggest problem if someone actually wants to find the place. A May 2026 post asks whether anybody is there; that is recent interest, not proof of cruising. Tripla’s operator says pedestrian routes are generally open 06:00–24:00, while a first-floor supermarket passage stays accessible around the clock. That does not make every toilet open 24 hours, so the previous description was too generous about overnight access. Until there’s a better toilet location or a firsthand recent account, this is more of a tentative lead than somewhere I’d recommend travelling across Helsinki for.

patches.name: Ponte fiume Reno a Borgo Panigale

proposed_fields.Description: This is not an unidentified bridge. The original Italian directory points to the riverside park underneath Bologna’s Pontelungo, where Via Emilia Ponente meets Via del Triumvirato in Borgo Panigale. It describes cruising on foot around the bridge and park and historically mentions paid encounters, though those older statements say nothing reliable about the present crowd. The original driving-map reference is 44.511105, 11.291295. Pontelungo’s roadworks have been completed, but a reopened road does not verify that the riverside paths below remain unchanged. The May 2026 directory message was simply asking who might be there at night, not reporting an encounter. Use the bridge and river park as the location reference rather than treating any random Reno crossing as equivalent.

patches.name: Bagni Palazzo Reale

proposed_fields.Description: Palazzo Reale is Milan's exhibition palace beside the Duomo, and the old cruising listing is about its visitor toilets rather than the surrounding piazza. There are two, but the museum makes an important access distinction: the ground-floor WC is near the Scalone d'Onore staircase, whereas the first-floor toilet is by exhibition room 143 and serves people attending the current exhibitions. So these are not two general-purpose public toilets available at any time. The directory has a July 2026 online check-in, but that isn't an account of a meeting or even proof someone visited. With gallery opening hours, ticketing and staff supervision, this is a very tentative cruising lead. The verified building layout is useful, but it would be misleading to suggest guaranteed cruising or free access upstairs.

patches.name: Aquadrom Pool

proposed_fields.Description: Aquadrom is a public water park in Ruda Śląska, not Katowice, and the cruising claims are about the steam sauna rather than the swimming pools. The original directory recommends Saturday mornings and mentions men using the sauna, but its own old popularity ratings are not proof that it is busy now. June 2026 posts are more useful: one man described a good visit to the steam room, while another reported finding little happening during a late-morning visit. That mixed evidence suggests some interest without a dependable peak. You pay for a normal aquatic-centre visit here, and the saunarium has its own schedule: Monday–Wednesday from 12:00, Thursday–Friday from 10:00, weekends from 09:00, generally closing at 22:00. It isn’t a gay cruising sauna, so respect the facility’s rules and other users.

patches.name: Neeltje Jans

proposed_fields.Description: Neeltje Jans is a spacious coastal naturist beach on the seaward side of the Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier. A July 2026 visitor says the nude-bathing section now begins at the southern beach access, with clearer signage, and describes parking in the shade beneath the Roompotsluis viaduct. The same visitor warned that kitesurfers were operating unusually close to swimmers, so pay attention to the water as well as the weather. Older guestbook discussions mention men walking in the high dunes, but those are not fresh evidence of current cruising; the dunes themselves are protected and entering them is restricted. If you're going for a naturist beach day, the place and access are well documented. If you're going specifically for cruising, the present reports don't establish reliable activity or a permitted area.

patches.name: Spektepark

proposed_fields.Description: Spektepark in Berlin-Spandau stretches around Großer Spektesee, with lawns, walking paths and a car park off Am Kiesteich. The older cruising guide specifically described scrub beside a path from the parking area down towards the lake, rather than the entire park. But the most recent July 2026 forum comment simply asks whether anything still happens, and earlier posts are mixed—so there is no credible present-day cruising timetable. There have also been access changes: the Spektelakesteg I pedestrian bridge was closed after damage in June 2026, although other nearby bridges had reopened. One important correction to older notices: Spandau's 31 August water-quality warning was lifted on 14 September after improved test results. The park is open recreation space; neither that former warning nor the bridge works establishes closure of the whole park.

patches.name: Uni-See

proposed_fields.Description: Bremen's Uni-See, officially Stadtwaldsee, has long been popular for swimming and FKK sunbathing. The original cruising guide was more specific than the previous description: it mentioned reeds and wooded ground between Hochschulring and Uni-Wildnis, reached from the western side. Those historic paths may not look the same today. A March 2026 visitor reported that high bushes around the parking area had been cleared, reducing privacy, while a June forum post asked why woodland by the naturist area had been fenced. There is also a separate, serious access issue: northern-shore stabilisation work was scheduled to start in November 2026, with temporary fences and dangerous loose sand until it settles. The FKK beach itself is on the eastern shore; it is not automatically the reported cruising section. Men may still visit, but there is no trustworthy fixed peak or guaranteed clear path.

That makes a good-weather afternoon a reported possibility, not a guarantee. Use the source's road and bridge as the location, not a generic Munich pin; check lawful parking and riverside access.
